gloss: to be able to, to be made

definitions.explanation: To have the ability to do something.

definitions.gloss: to be made, to be completed
definitions.explanation: For something to come into existence.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}が{出来|でき}る。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{料理|りょうり}も{出来|でき}るし、ピアノも{出来|でき}る。
examples.english: She can cook and play the piano.

examples.japanese: ご{飯|はん}が{出来|でき}た。
{準備|じゅんび}が{出来|でき}た。
{駅|えき}の{近|ちか}くに{新|あたら}しいスーパーが{出来|でき}た。
examples.english: A new supermarket opened near the station.

notes:
{出来|でき}る is an ichidan verb with two main meanings: ability and completion/creation.

TRANSITIVITY:
Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)

PATTERNS FOR ABILITY:
- Xが{出来|でき}る: can do X, be able to do X
- V-ることが{出来|でき}る: can do V (more formal than V-られる)

PATTERNS FOR COMPLETION:
- {準備|じゅんび}が{出来|でき}た: preparations are done
- ご{飯|はん}が{出来|でき}た: the meal is ready

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {出来|でき}るだけ: as much as possible
- {出来|でき}れば: if possible
- {出来|でき}るかぎり: to the best of one's ability

NOTE:
Often written in hiragana as できる in casual writing.
